paragraphs.text: Deterministic, MCP-native delivery QA for AI-generated web pages
# ego-webqa
Deterministic coarse delivery QA for AI-generated web pages, H5 demos, and PWAs.

Point it at a URL. It opens the page in a real Chromium browser by default,
checks a zero-config nar

row-mobile matrix, safely probes the primary call to
action, and leaves screenshots plus machine-rea

dable evidence behind. Firefox
and Playwright WebKit can be selected one engine at a time. The defau

lt eight
variants combine:
## See the result in 30 seconds

Prefer to inspect a completed run first? Open the
live before-and-after evidence board.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`setup` first checks the selected browser. If it already launches, setup exits
without downloading a

nything; otherwise it installs the pinned Playwright
headless shell with the active `ego-webqa` Pyth

on interpreter and verifies a
real headless launch. The first Chromium setup avoids the full headed

browser
build because audits only run headless. Ordinary `doctor` and audit commands
never download

a browser implicitly. The
audit command exits `0` for pass/warnings, `1` for blocking delivery defec

ts,
and `2` for an audit or browser failure. Each run leaves screenshots and
structured evidence:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
A real dogfood finding looks like this:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The report explains what broke, where it happened, which viewport combinations
were affected, and gi
ves the Agent a command that reproduces the failure.
## What real pages exposed

The v0.8.2 dogfood pass audited all 20 Ego-owned production or canonical
generated pages with zero r

untime errors. After separating network-sensitive
performance observations from deterministic delive

ry findings, ten pages were
clean and ten had actionable structural findings. Stable failures includ

ed six
text-enlargement layout breaks, four bottom safe-area penetrations, five
clipped-text root ca

uses, four undersized-target groups, and one generated page
loading a missing service worker. There

are no known stable blocking false
positives in this corpus. This is a small, disclosed corpus rathe

r than a
market-wide accuracy claim; the full evidence, raw mixed-profile counts, and
limitations ar

e in
`docs/real-world-dogfood-2026-10-31-v0.8.2.md`.

Layout failures now identify the deepest unclipped elements that own the
overflow, so an Agent recei
ves a concrete repair selector instead of `html`.

See how one generated page went from three root causes to zero blocking defects
in the
vocabulary re

pair case study.
If you want to test the same loop on one of your pages, follow the
15-minute first-

trial protocol.
The field feedback protocol defines how real cases
are classified and converted into
clean controls or benchmark fixtures.
## Why

Generated pages often pass unit tests while still shipping obvious delivery
defects: content wider t

han the phone, invisible buttons, broken images,
console errors, a call-to-action that does nothing,

or a page that shifts while
the user is trying to tap it.

`ego-webqa` turns those into deterministic checks. It is not a visual-regression
service and does no
t require writing tests or storing approved screenshots.

Install the published package from PyPI:

For development, use the committed lockfile:

Without `uv`, `python -m pip install -e '.[dev]'` remains supported.

If `uv` is available and you do not want a persistent Python package install,
use the same commands
through an isolated, version-pinned `uvx` environment:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Playwright is pinned by the package, and browser binaries live in Playwright's
shared cache, so the

temporary `uvx` environment and later MCP launches reuse
the same browser revision.
If `doctor` reports missing Linux system libraries, ask setup to install them:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Setup is intentionally a separate, explicit command: wheel installs remain
offline-safe, while brows

er downloads and operating system changes are visible,
retryable user actions. `setup` is idempotent

and reuses a browser that already
passes a real launch check. Use `setup --dry-run` to inspect the

exact
interpreter-bound command, or `--force` to reinstall a damaged browser revision.
For a lower-level repair or explicit installation command, use:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Chromium installation is headless-only by default. If another tool on the same
machine requires the
full headed Chromium build, opt in explicitly:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Use a system Chrome instead of downloading Chromium:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### Firefox and WebKit
Install only the additional engine you need, then select it for the whole audit:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Chromium remains the default. Each audit runs one engine; this does not silently
multiply browser co

st or claim cross-engine parity. The `webkit` option uses
Playwright's WebKit build and supplies use

ful Safari-engine evidence, but it is
not a real iPhone, iPad, or macOS Safari run. Use real-device

testing when the
delivery decision requires it.
## Use
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Exit codes:

- `0`: pass or warnings only
- `1`: at least one blocking error
- `2`: invalid invocation or browser

arnings only
- `1`: at least one blocking error
- `2`: invalid invocation or browser/runtime failure

`--viewports` accepts `WIDTHxHEIGHT[:NAME][@TEXT_SCALE][~SAFE_BOTTOM_PX]`.
Explicit viewports replac

e the default matrix. Text scale must be between 1.0
and 2.0; the simulated bottom safe area must be
between 0 and 100px.

`--preset quick` selects four pairwise-balanced mobile variants for fast Agent
loops: each width cov

ers both text scales and both safe-area states, while the
crossed scale/safe-area combinations alter

nate by width. `--preset full`
explicitly selects the default eight-variant matrix. A preset cannot

be combined
with `--viewports`.

Every run writes self-contained evidence. Screenshot references in JSON are
relative to the report d

irectory, so agents and CI can move the complete
